# Frank Tindle

> Operations executive. Thirty-one years building the teams that keep
> businesses running. Based in the London area, UK.

## Summary

Frank Tindle is an operations and technology executive with 31 years in the
video games industry, currently IT & Operations Director at Supermassive Games.

## Career

- **Supermassive Games** (2010–present): IT & Operations Director. Joined at 30
  employees; the studio grew to a multi-site group peaking at 387 staff, peak turnover
  of £39.1M (FY2022), and was acquired by Nordisk Games (Egmont) in July 2022.
  Built the operations function from a standing start to a team of 16, covering IT,
  workplace support, facilities, physical and cyber security, events and
  procurement. Operating budget grew from £200K to a peak of £6M. Member of the
  Senior Leadership Team.
- **Criterion Games / Electronic Arts** (2000–2008): Head of IT, then Head of
  Operations, then Senior Manager, IT Services. IT integration following EA's £40M
  acquisition in 2004, covering Guildford, Paris, Austin and Tokyo, 300+ employees,
  with no disruption to game releases.
- **Iguana Entertainment / Acclaim Studios Teesside** (1995–1999): Manager, MIS
  and Operations (1995–1997), then Director of Operations (1997–1999). Built a
  unified email system across sites in New York, Austin, Utah and the UK.

## Areas of expertise

Post-acquisition integration (three acquisitions across three decades), scaling
operations through rapid growth, org design and workforce change through both
growth and contraction, office moves and estates, business continuity,
cyber and physical security, procurement and vendor management, and applying AI
to back-office work.
